reviews.comment: Dr. Yan is a really great professor. Her lectures were clear and she explained things well. Her tests were similar to the homework and practice tests, and were a mix of multiple choice and free response. Overall I felt she was really generous and flexible with students.

She does a lot of practice problems in her lecture and uploads her ppts with the work. Practice all of those problems, the additional practice problems, and the practice exam and you're solid for the actual test. She is very understanding and gives curves/test adjustments if necessary. Attendance mandatory, won't round up if ur off bc of attendance

Dr. Yan is an extremely efficient and helpful instructor! The material was difficult without taking her lectures, but she explained things very well and it was easy for me to follow. She also encouraged us to ask questions in class and she answered questions with additional explanations. She responded emails very fast. Highly recommended!

Xin Yan is no doubt the best professor in the entire chemistry department. She's extremely caring and accessible outside of class. She responds to emails incredibly fast, even late at night. Her tests are extremely easy. They're all multiple choice and there are no trick questions/answers. Her mock exams are very similar to the actual exams. Easy A

Let me start off by saying ALEKS is the most rage inducing thing to ever exist and I totally have not broken a few tables doing them. Her exams are VERY close to the practice exams, just do the practice, understand the answers, then viola! your A (you can get up to 108% on a few of the exams)

I really loved Dr. Yan's class for 120 because I found the material difficult on my own but her lectures and homework assignments helped make it a lot more manageable. She's super quick top respond to emails, willing to be flexible to help students, and genuinely cares about your success in her class. Plus, she does fun demonstrations in class!

Yan explained everything very clearly and always answered questions. She gives practice exams that are very similar to the exam. You could correct exams for partial credit as well so write down every step on the exam. Homework was ALEKS but it didn't help much. Super accommodating and sweet. 10/10 recommend.

Dr Yan is the GOAT. Her lectures are easy to follow. Her test reviews help us see what the test is going to look like. And she makes the content feel very easy to understand and do. She is rly nice also, and sometimes she performs chem demonstrations and calls up random students as volunteers. Take her!!

Professor Yan made Chem 120 enjoyable and as simple as possible. Her Lectures were very planned out and would provide many practice problems in her lectures. Whenever test time came around, she made a whole mock exam that is 98% like the exam besides changing the numbers. Attendance was mandatory as she would do clickers. Overall 10/10

As you can tell from everyone else, this prof is super easy. Her tests were pretty much exactly like the practice exams. Got a 99 in the class. Just hope she prepared me enough for ochem. Overall I really enjoyed her class.

Professor Yan has been my favorite professor in college. She told us what was expected of us in her class to succeed. The tests were not hard if you did studiedied. Participation matters because she asks questions in class. The course does come with a lot of homework, but that's all of CHEM. I would take her again.

Yan is great. Her exams are very straightforward and almost exactly like the practice exams. Exams have extra credit questions on them as well. Attendance is important if you want to get credit for participation. She does tend to speak very quietly so try to sit near the front.

Make sure you attend class for the clicker points because they will effect your grade. You can use the mock exams to study and pass the class as thats what I did. She makes the class very interesting and the material through her is fairly easy to understand. She is kind and understanding. This class is a very doable A if you put in the work. Yan

She makes her tests extremely easy, as our second exam average was a 95! All exams are multiple choice w an 8-pt bonus. They are very similar (identical w different numbers) to the mock exam she gives before each one. The course content is less conceptual and is more math-heavy, but the ALEKS hw and lecture slides should prepare you for it.

Best chem professor! Genuinely cares about student success, and basically hands you the material needed to make an A. Mock exams are nearly identical to the real thing, and she doesn't use tricky or super convoluted questions. Unlike other chem profs, her lectures are actually super helpful! Didn't have to reference the textbook once.

Best chem professor ever! Exams are multiple choice and very similar to the mock exam as well as extra practice problems and lecture problems practiced in class. Answers emails very quickly, and definitely wants to help you succeed. Also extra credit opportunities available. Chemistry is hard for a lot of people, but she made it easy to understand.

Yan is the FYP chemistry departments best kept secret. Take her!!! She is so amazing and WAY better than any other first year program professor. Her tests are all multiple choice unlike the others which have free response. Amazing!

Best prof I've ever taken!!! She made Chem 120 feels like the easiest class as long as you put some effort. Go to lectures, she goes over the materials fast but it's understandable, also does practice problems in class which was extremely helpful. Do the practice exams and understand them well and you should be fine. She is very sweet and caring :)

Professor Yan was an amazing prof- one of the best i've ever had. She truly cares about her students. She gives you every resource necessary to succeed. Don't get me wrong, Chemistry is not a blow off course, you still have to put in the work. Your grade is 4 tests, ALEKS, Lab, and iClicker questions. She gives you a bonus question on each test.

I took this class after having been in Honors CHEM 119 so this was a very big difference. You have a lot of ALEKS topics but they are really helpful if you work through them. The mock exams are also really close to the actual exams especially if you also do the extra practice problems. I really enjoyed this class and did not have any difficulties.

Best professor I have had so far at A&M. She genuinely care about the success of her students which I can't say about some. Lectures are required to get in class clicker points, but material is easy to follow and practice problems given in class and mock exams are extremely helpful. Overall amazing and would recommend to everyone.

Professor Yan is great for CHEM 120. She provides "mock exams" to work out/study for her tests and they are a very good gauge of what will be tested. You do have to be in class because of daily clicker questions. Overall great prof.

Dr. Yan is amazing! She's very good at explaining calculations and concepts so that it's easy to understand. She uses ALEKS but only assigns 9 hw's in total so every 1-2 wks, and no pie completion. She grades the tests fast and they're just like the practice tests. She also gives example probs. in lecture, extra probs. for practice and her notes.

Dr. Yan is literally so amazing. Her practice tests are just like the actual test, and she explain things very well. ALEKS hw are annoying but it is not avoidable whoever you decided to take. Many bonus points throughout the course. Easy multiple choice tests.

Professor Yan is the best CHEM 120 professor! Her lectures are designed in a way that's easy to follow and there's plenty of preparatory extra practice available to get high grades on the exams. I would definitely take her again if I had a choice!

Prof. Yan is the GOAT. She is dedicated to genuinely helping students understand the topics covered. For my class, she provided extra practice problems and a very helpful mock exam every test cycle. She also responds to emails incredibly quickly. Plenty of oppritunity to make an A in 120, especially since exams are multiple choice.

Professor Yan was very good. Her lectures were very clear and perfectly related to the material on her exams. Being a person who struggled in chem 119, she truly made chem 120 enjoyable. I highly recommend her if you are looking for a professor who is helpful, understanding, and not too heavy on homework.

Dr. Yan is the BEST professor I have had during my time at Texas A&M. I 100% recommend her, especially if chemistry isn't your strong point. She does lecture a bit fast, but is more than willing to re-explain things. She provides practice problems and mock exams that are very similar to the exams. The Aleks homework is quite heavy but it helps.

Professor Yan is a good teacher and she gives you opportunities to earn extra credit on tests. For tests, study with the extra practice problems and the mock exam, and you'll be fine. Sometimes if she's behind with the lecture she'll extend ALEKS due date.

Such a good prof! I had a pretty terrible prof for chem 119 my first semester so I was nervous when selecting a prof. Her tests are practically replicas of her mock exams and she offers a bonus question on every test so each exam is graded out of 108 points. She really cares about her students success and was always understanding. Take Yan for 120!

Do the practice problems over and over until you get all of the questions correct and boom: 108 on every exam. I'm not even kidding. There's a bonus ?s on every exam. Average on each test: 87, 94, 82. As long as you know how to do the problems, you'll be fine. Equation sheet has everything on it youll ever need. ALEKS hw is a lot sometimes.

She is the best chem professor! Her test are exactly like the mock exam and she provides so many extra problems and really wants you to do good in her class. She is very caring and cares a lot about her students. She sometimes will extend a deadline and she is really good at explaining things. She does demonstrations in class and answers questions

Dr. Yan is an amazing prof. Her tests were EXACTLY like the mock exam, with some numbers changed. Tests were 14 multiple choice questions with one bonus question. She frequently changed due dates to give us more breathing room. One thing I will note, you might get a better grade in her class, but may actually learn more with Bethel.

She tends to talk fast while going through the slides but is more than willing to go back and repeat. ALEKS sucked but that's out of her control,iClicker matters, and she gives mock exams. Study the mock exams really well and you'll get an A she makes them VERY similar to the actual exam. Overall one of the best choices for a chem prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I registered for a different prof, but at the last second Yan replaced him. I was nervous I was going to be stuck with a bad prof but she ended up being great! The tests are hard, but she is understanding and curves the class (A88%, B 77%, etc.) The ALEKS homework is annoying, but all 120 classes use it so it is unavoidable no matter who you take

Dr. Yan is an amazing professor. She does go through lectures really quickly but if you spend an hour beforehand preparing for it you should be fine. Aleks the homework was a pain. But she gives a lot of practice problems and a mock exam with answers. As long as your prepare for the lecture do Aleks and study the exam this class should be easy.

Dr. Yan was a real gem. She is very sweet and cares for her students a lot. She always posts her lectures online for us to review and gives us mock exams (with answers) before each exam which are very very similar to the real exam. I would love to take her again for future chemistry classes. Best professor ever in the chemistry department at A&M!(:

I clicker points in class so you have to go. I just taught myself with ALEKS and it wasn't that bad. Gives a mock exam with a key before every exam and they are VERY similar to the actual thing. Do those and know what you're doing and you'll do fine.

Dr. Yan is a solid choice for CHEM 120. She accommodated to us being an online class. ALEKS is the major homework that takes up most of the time. Other than that, Dr. Yan taught what we needed to know for the exams. She also provided mock exams which were very helpful. She responds quickly to emails and answers questions. Great prof.

Professor Yan taught in accordance to what would be tested on the test. She also provides mock exams that are similar to the test. She is very receptive to questions, but goes through topics quickly. There is weekly homework and labs but if you are a quick learner and willing to do the work the course is an easy A. My favorite professor so far!
Dr. Yan is a caring and understanding professor who wants students to do well. The tests are difficult. However, she gives lots of practice problems and mock exams that mimic the test.

Professor Yan was very understanding and gives you a lot of opportunities to bring your grade up through bonus points on exams and is understanding in moving homework due dates. As long as you pay attention to her lectures, do your assignments, and take the mock exams before the tests, her class isnt hard to learn and pass.

Dr. Yan is a great professor. The class is very difficult so you do have to work very hard, but she is always open to suggestions and answers all questions. Take advantage of the practice exams and don't get lazy on the homework or REEF questions, I know it can be a lot but if you do it those points can really make a difference at the end.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Great Professor. You do have to put in a lot of work to make a good grade in the class. But she looks out for her students and wants them all to succeed. She always answers her emails asap. Take her if you wanna want to excel in chemistry

Dr. Yan is a very nice lady and she does have good intentions, but I found myself really struggling to do well in the class. She flies through the powerpoints and will only fully explain something if you ask. If not, then she'll do 1-2 questions and assume you understand. Overall a nice person but doesn't really "teach", just reads off powerpoint.

Dr. Yan was a very sweet lady, and she often listened to our class's feedback in regards to tests, reef points, etc.. I will say she does kind of go fast through lecture and there have been times when we had to ask her to slow down. However, she wants what is best for her students, and is willing to help you.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Yan thoroughly explains topics and she is always available for questions. If you follow her instructions, do online homework, and practice problems, you can pass the exam.
She is a bit hard to understand which can make the class a little harder. Other than that she isn't too bad.
If you can do the online homeworks ur good
